text: # TechCart — Frequently Asked Questions

## Ordering

**Do I need an account to place an order?**
No. TechCart supports guest checkout — you can browse, add items to your cart, and complete a purchase without creating an account.

## Ordering

**Can I modify or cancel an order after placing it?**
Orders can be modified or cancelled within 1 hour of purchase, as long as the order has not yet entered the "Processing" stage. Contact customer support immediately if you need to make a change.

## Ordering

**How do I know if an item is in stock?**
Each product page displays real-time stock availability. If an item shows "In stock," it is available for immediate shipping.

## Payment

**What payment methods are accepted?**
TechCart accepts major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), as well as PayPal.

## Payment

**Is my payment information secure?**
Yes. All transactions are encrypted and processed through PCI-DSS compliant payment providers. TechCart never stores your full card number.

## Payment

**Why was my payment declined?**
Common reasons include insufficient funds, incorrect card details, or a bank security flag on international purchases. Contact your bank first; if the issue persists, reach out to TechCart support.

## Shipping

**How long does shipping take?**
Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days. Express shipping (where available) takes 1–2 business days. See the Shipping Policy document for full details.

## Shipping

**Do you ship internationally?**
Currently, TechCart ships within the country of operation only. International shipping is not yet supported.

## Shipping

**Can I track my order?**
Yes. Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number by email.

## Returns & Warranty

**What is your return policy?**
Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, provided they are unused and in original packaging. See the Return Policy document for exclusions and full conditions.

## Returns & Warranty

**Are products covered by warranty?**
Yes. All products sold on TechCart include the manufacturer's standard warranty. See the Warranty Policy document for details on coverage and claims.

## Products

**Are the products new or refurbished?**
Unless explicitly stated otherwise on the product page, all items sold on TechCart are brand new, sealed in original manufacturer packaging.

## Products

**Can you help me choose between two components?**
Yes — the TechCart assistant can compare specifications, price, and stock availability between products to help you decide.
# Buying Guide: Choosing a GPU

## Understand Your Use Case First

- **Gaming at 1080p:** A mid-range GPU is generally sufficient for high frame rates at this resolution.
- **Gaming at 1440p or 4K:** Prioritize higher VRAM (8GB+) and a stronger core/boost clock.
- **Content creation / rendering:** Prioritize VRAM capacity and CUDA/compute core count over raw gaming benchmarks.

## Key Specifications to Compare

- **VRAM (memory):** More VRAM helps with higher resolutions, texture-heavy games, and multitasking (streaming while gaming, for example).
- **Core clock / boost clock:** Higher clock speeds generally mean better raw performance within the same GPU generation.
- **Power draw (TDP):** Check that your power supply unit (PSU) can support the card's rated power draw, plus headroom for the rest of the system.
- **Physical size:** Confirm the card's length and width fit your case before purchasing.

## Budget vs. Performance

A higher price does not always mean proportionally higher performance — price-to-performance ratio often peaks in the mid-range tier of each GPU generation. If budget is a primary constraint, compare price per frame rather than raw specifications alone.

## Compatibility Checklist

Before finalizing a purchase, verify:
- The card fits physically inside your case.
- Your power supply has the required connectors and sufficient wattage.
- Your motherboard has a free PCIe slot of the appropriate generation.

## When in Doubt

Ask the TechCart assistant to compare two specific models side by side — it can pull real-time specifications, pricing, and stock availability to help you decide.
# Payment Information

## Accepted Payment Methods

TechCart accepts the following payment methods for orders in Algeria:

- CIB bank cards.
- Edahabia cards.
- Algerian bank cards supported by the payment gateway.
- Cash on delivery for eligible delivery areas.

## Currency

All TechCart prices are displayed in Algerian dinars (DZD / DA).

For example:

- 25,000 DA
- 145,000 DA
- 320,000 DA

The amount shown at checkout is the amount charged for the order.

## Payment at Checkout

For online card payments, the payment is confirmed during checkout.

For cash-on-delivery orders, payment is made when the order is delivered.

## Payment Security

TechCart does not store the complete bank card number in its own application database.

Online card transactions are handled through the configured payment service.

## Failed Payment

If an online payment is declined, the order is not confirmed.

Possible reasons include:

- Insufficient account balance.
- Incorrect card information.
- A temporary bank restriction.
- A payment gateway error.

If the amount appears to have been debited but the order was not confirmed, keep the payment reference and contact TechCart support.

## Refunds

When a refund is approved, the amount is returned using the applicable payment method.

The time required for the refund may depend on the bank or payment service.

## Important Note

The payment methods available for a specific order may depend on the delivery area and the payment options enabled by TechCart at checkout.
# Return and Refund Policy

## Return Window

Most items purchased on TechCart may be returned within 30 calendar days of the delivery date, provided the conditions below are met.

## Eligibility Conditions

To be eligible for a return, an item must be:
- Unused and in the same condition as received.
- In its original packaging, with all accessories, manuals, and included parts.
- Accompanied by proof of purchase (order number or receipt).

## Non-Returnable Items

The following items cannot be returned once opened, for hygiene, security, or licensing reasons:
- Software with a broken seal or activated license key.
- Custom-built or made-to-order systems.
- Items marked "Final Sale" on the product page.

## How to Start a Return

1. Contact customer support with your order number and the reason for the return.
2. Support will confirm eligibility and provide a return authorization and shipping label.
3. Pack the item securely with all original contents and ship it back within 14 days of receiving the return authorization.

## Refunds

Once the returned item is received and inspected, a refund is issued to the original payment method within 5–10 business days. Shipping costs are non-refundable unless the return is due to a TechCart error (wrong item shipped, defective on arrival).

## Exchanges

Exchanges for a different product are handled as a return followed by a new order, rather than a direct swap, to keep processing times predictable.

## Defective Items

If an item is defective on arrival, contact support within 7 days of delivery. Defective items are eligible for a full refund or replacement, including return shipping costs.
# Shipping Policy

## Processing Time

Orders are processed within 1 business day of payment confirmation. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day.

## Shipping Methods and Delivery Times

| Method            | Estimated Delivery | Cost                          |
|-------------------|---------------------|--------------------------------|
| Standard Shipping | 3–5 business days   | Free on orders over $75; otherwise $6.99 |
| Express Shipping  | 1–2 business days   | $14.99                        |

Delivery times are estimates and start counting from the date of shipment, not the date of order.

## Order Tracking

Once an order ships, a confirmation email containing a tracking number and carrier link is sent automatically. Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to become active.

## Shipping Coverage

TechCart currently ships to addresses within the country of operation only. We do not offer international shipping at this time.

## Delayed or Lost Shipments

If a shipment appears delayed beyond the estimated delivery window, or if tracking shows no movement for more than 5 business days, contact customer support with the order number for investigation.

## Shipping Damage

If a package arrives visibly damaged, do not discard the packaging. Take photos of the damage and contact support within 48 hours of delivery to initiate a claim.
# About TechCart

## Who We Are

TechCart is an online retailer specializing in computer hardware and components — GPUs, CPUs, and related accessories — for gamers, PC builders, and professionals.

## What We Sell

- Graphics cards (GPUs) from major manufacturers (NVIDIA, AMD).
- Processors (CPUs), including Intel product lines.
- Compatible accessories and components.

## Customer Support

- **Availability:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (store's local time zone).
- **Channels:** Live chat (this assistant), email support, and a help center with self-service articles.
- **Response time:** Live chat is answered instantly during business hours; email inquiries are answered within 1 business day.

## Store Values

- Transparent pricing and real-time stock accuracy.
- Genuine, manufacturer-sealed products only.
- Clear, predictable shipping, return, and warranty policies.

## Assistant Scope

The TechCart assistant can help with:
- Finding products by specification, price range, or brand.
- Comparing two or more products.
- Checking real-time stock availability.
- Answering questions about shipping, returns, warranty, and payment, based on the store's official policies.

The assistant does not process payments, cancel orders, or access personal account information — those actions require contacting human customer support.
# Warranty Policy

## Standard Coverage

All new products sold on TechCart are covered by the manufacturer's standard warranty, starting from the delivery date. Warranty duration varies by product category and manufacturer:

| Category      | Typical Warranty Duration |
|---------------|----------------------------|
| GPUs          | 2–3 years (manufacturer-dependent) |
| CPUs          | 3 years (manufacturer-dependent)   |
| Accessories   | 1 year                     |

Exact warranty duration for a specific product is listed on its product page.

## What Is Covered

The manufacturer's warranty covers defects in materials or workmanship under normal use. This includes component failure not caused by external damage, misuse, or unauthorized modification.

## What Is Not Covered

- Physical damage (drops, liquid damage, burns).
- Damage caused by overclocking beyond manufacturer specifications.
- Damage from improper installation (e.g., incorrect power connector, physical force).
- Cosmetic wear that does not affect functionality.
- Products with tampered or removed warranty seals.

## How to Make a Warranty Claim

1. Contact TechCart support with your order number, a description of the issue, and photos or videos if applicable.
2. Support will determine whether the issue is covered and whether the claim should be handled directly by TechCart or forwarded to the manufacturer.
3. Depending on the manufacturer's process, you may be asked to ship the item to TechCart or directly to an authorized service center.

## Claim Resolution

Approved warranty claims are resolved by repair, replacement, or store credit, at TechCart's discretion, depending on part availability and manufacturer policy. Typical resolution time is 10–20 business days from the day the item is received for inspection.
